text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a corner of the cafeteria— 
Rice Shower and the others were preparing 
something.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Now then. 
Let us arrange the preserved flowers— 
while keeping the overall harmony in mind.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wow, they're all so pretty... 
Um... B-Bouquet-san! 
Thank you for helping me make these...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mmm～♪ 
Your homemade cookies were 
absolutely delicious, Rice-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Result of Operation 'Taste Test'— 
Data indicates a 99.8% probability 
of total satisfaction from everyone.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
What a relief... 
Now we just have to keep baking and 
wrapping them.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
To everyone who's always working so hard, 
this is just a small gesture... 
but please enjoy this treat to soothe your 
fatigue...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I watched with curiosity, that corner 
of the cafeteria 
had transformed into a wonderfully 
soothing haven. 
Eye-catching flowers and baskets filled 
with homemade cookies.
choice_data_list:
Is this what you've been working on all 
this time?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! Um... I-If you'd like, 
Trainer-san... please have a cookie too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Found it!! 
This is it! The place F's destiny was 
calling out to!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
—... 
Those flowers.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um...! 
They're lovely flowers, aren't they? 
Rice was totally captivated the first time 
she saw them too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Please take your time... and enjoy them. 
Also, the cookies... I made them in 
different flower shapes... 
I-If you'd like some...!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: Eh, ah—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Of course we'll take some, F!! 
Thanks a lot, Rice!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: ...Cute.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Waaah～, smells so good! 
There are so many yummy-looking cookies～.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, Spe-chan. 
Didn't you say we were about to go for a 
tandem run?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, yes, but... it caught my 
attention. 
Just for a second, if I could just enjoy 
the smell...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... In that case, I can bring some over 
later, okay? 
They have ingredients that help relieve 
fatigue... 
so please have some after your training.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Are you sure? 
In that case, I'll gladly take you up on 
that.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yay!! 
I feel all fired up now, you betcha～!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... Quite a flourishing success, it 
seems. 
I am delighted to see that 
you have found your own path...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Chitose O-san...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Ehehe. 
In my own little way... 
Rice was able to deliver a little bit of 
happiness, I think...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: MAAARVELOUS☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing☆ 
Did you set all this up, Rice!? 
The flowers and the cookies are all so 
utterly marvelousっ★

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh? B-But... 
Compared to Marvelous-san, it's not 
mystical or flashy at all...—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? 
Just take a good look around you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
These are the flowers from back then, 
aren't they? 
...No matter when I see them, they bring 
peace to my heart.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The decorations are so lovely and warm, 
too... 
Your heartfelt feelings have truly reached 
us, Rice-san.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Good for nourishment, easy to carry... 
I'll bring them along for training.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I'll see even better results than 
usual. 
Fufu. Thank you very much, Rice-san.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list:
Everyone has such a happy smile on their 
face!

Everyone has such a happy smile on their 
face, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That's right. You accomplished something 
truly sparkling, Rice-san, so 
I think you have every right to feel 
proud, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
'The benevolent love others'— 
Rice-san, 
you truly embody those words.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm... I'm so glad... 
I brought so much happiness...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice was able... to make everyone smile!
